newsitem.title: USA: Clinton ends duties on West Bank, Gaza goods.
newsitem.headline: Clinton ends duties on West Bank, Gaza goods.

text.p: President Bill Clinton has signed legislation granting duty free status to goods from the West Bank and Gaza Strip sold in the United States, the White House said Thursday.
"This new trade initiative reflects the continuing commitment of the United States to help open new economic opportunities for the Palestinian people," White House Press Secretary Mike McCurry said.
The move was designed "to spur economic development throughout the region," McCurry said in a statement issued by the White House.
The Palestinians, in exchange, have granted duty free access to U.S.-made goods.
